title: California and Texas lead in paranormal search volume
excerpt: A study by Gamble Mind revealed that Americans conduct nearly 1.6 million haunting-related Google searches every month, with California and Texas leading the nation in total search volume.
content:
DALLAS (KDAF) — Americans perform 1,598,700 haunting-related Google searches each month, averaging roughly 52,560 searches daily or one every 1.6 seconds.

According to a study by Gamble Mind, California and Texas generate the highest total search volume for paranormal topics in the country. Gamble Mind analyzed search volumes for 50 paranormal-related terms across all 50 states, evaluating terms ranging from “poltergeist signs” and “ghost hunters” to “spirit box” and “Ouija board.”


STUDY: America’s top 10 most convinced they’re haunted states by total searches

California leads all states with 212,950 monthly searches, edging out Texas at 212,900 monthly searches. Combined, the two states account for 26.6% of all haunting-related search volume nationwide, with both states generating an estimated 50,000 monthly searches each for the terms “psychic,” “poltergeist” and “Ouija board.”

New York ranks third overall with 108,100 monthly searches. Hiring-related terms comprise 67% of New York’s searches, compared with 41% nationally. Florida follows with 63,100 searches, Pennsylvania with 53,200 and Ohio with 51,850. Together, the top 10 states account for 53.5% of all haunting-related search activity in the United States.

Alaska, Vermont, and Wyoming recorded the lowest total search volumes in the country, averaging 4,000 monthly searches each. However, when adjusted per 100,000 residents, Utah leads the nation with 778 searches per 100,000 residents, followed by Connecticut with 746 and Wyoming with 679. Mississippi recorded the lowest rate in the country at 244 searches per 100,000 residents.

STUDY: What are Americans searching for?

Searches for people to hire — including psychics, mediums, ghost hunters, demonologists and exorcists — represent the largest category of inquiries at 40.6%, or 648,950 searches per month. Equipment searches, including spirit boxes, EMF meters and Ouija boards, make up 34.6% of searches at 553,850 per month. Searches regarding poltergeists and entities account for 18.8%, while haunted places and tours comprise 4.8%.

“Psychic” is the single most-searched term, drawing 299,500 searches per month and appearing in 26.3% of all haunting-related inquiries. In contrast, worried homeowner queries such as “is my home haunted” make up 1.1% of total searches, or 18,350 monthly, though searches for “is my house haunted address search” increased 5,000% in October.
